item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 22/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China will moderate slightly today and tomorrow. It will be mainly fine over the region. Under the influence of the replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windy over the coastal areas over the weekend. A broad area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific will move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
